name: insights
description: How you really work with Claude Code, rebuilt from the files it keeps on your machine. /insights:my-agentic-setup scans your sessions, settings, plugins, skills, hooks and the git repos Claude Code ran in, runs one AI pass through your own Claude Code session, and writes one local page: what you do, what you built, part by part, and what to try next. Opens on Your level: the level your laptop reads, as a starting point a call confirms or raises (AGENTIC_SETUP_NO_LEVEL=1 leaves it out). Reads only; nothing leaves the machine unless you press Send on the page. Python 3.12+ or uv.
